ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram above, the letter A stands for what?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a diagram of the frog life cycle, with orange arrows connecting the different stages in order. At the top are eggs, labeled B; on the right side there is a small swimming organism with a round head, a long tail, and no legs, labeled A beside it; at the lower right is the stage where legs begin to grow, labeled F; at the lower left and left side are stages closer to a young frog and an adult frog. Reasoning: The question asks what the letter A represents. A is labeled beside a frog larva with a round head and long tail that has not yet developed legs; this stage in the frog life cycle is called a tadpole.
